stages.label: 收势站立
stages.text: A person smoothly finishes their movement and turns by lifting and replanting alternating feet in small separated steps, shifting weight over the supporting foot without sliding or twisting a planted foot to face the walking path and comes to a relaxed upright standing pose, feet hip-width apart and arms clear of the torso.

stages.label: 自然行走
stages.text: A person walks forward along a smooth curved path, turning the body to face the direction of travel, never walking backwards, with alternating hip-width steps on separate tracks, firm planted support feet and relaxed arm swing, following the ground path.

stages.label: 减速站稳
stages.text: A person slows their walk, keeps facing forward along the path, turns by lifting and replanting alternating feet in small separated steps, shifting weight over the supporting foot without sliding or twisting a planted foot and comes to a balanced relaxed stand at the destination.

stages.label: 接入后段
stages.text: A person turns by lifting and replanting alternating feet in small separated steps, shifting weight over the supporting foot without sliding or twisting a planted foot from relaxed standing to face the target direction and smoothly enters the target movement, matching its body pose and direction of motion.
